props.name: tag
props.description: Eyebrow label rendered in mono accent text above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title — rendered as the heading.

props.name: body
props.description: Optional body paragraph below the title. Use `children` for richer content.

props.name: href
props.description: Optional CTA href. When set, the Tile is rendered as `<a>` with hover-lift.

props.name: ctaLabel
props.description: Optional CTA label rendered as a footer link. Ignored when `href` is set on the whole tile.

props.name: ctaHref
props.description: Optional CTA href for the footer link.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual variant — drives the tag color and hover border tint.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes forwarded to the root element.
